import subprocess,json,os
f='/home/appontrack/public_html/saas/console/flow-ai-worker.php'
php='/opt/cpanel/ea-php83/root/usr/bin/php'
assert os.path.isfile(f) and os.path.isfile(php), 'worker_or_php_missing'
cur=subprocess.run(['crontab','-l'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=6)
if cur.returncode!=0:raise RuntimeError('crontab_read_failed')
old=cur.stdout
if 'flow-ai-worker.php' in old:
 print(json.dumps({'status':'already_installed','preserved':True}))
else:
 entry='* * * * * '+php+' '+f+' >/dev/null 2>&1 # ontrack-flow-ai-live-worker'
 new=old.rstrip('\n')+'\n'+entry+'\n'
 applied=subprocess.run(['crontab','-'],input=new,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=6)
 if applied.returncode!=0:raise RuntimeError('crontab_write_failed')
 check=subprocess.run(['crontab','-l'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=6)
 if check.returncode!=0 or entry not in check.stdout:
  subprocess.run(['crontab','-'],input=old,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=6)
  raise RuntimeError('cron_verify_failed_rollback_attempted')
 print(json.dumps({'status':'installed','preserved_existing':all(line in check.stdout for line in old.splitlines()),'flow_worker_count':check.stdout.count('flow-ai-worker.php')}))
